63/G.goal: Summarize the XR course's foundational coverage, scope, unaddressed XR areas, and further-learning direction.
63/G.achieves: reinforces the course's aim of providing foundational XR knowledge by helping the learner consolidate what was taught, identify what remains to be learned, and continue with confidence.
